description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to understand the proprietary 'buddha-companion' dialogue framework including the two-component '力道' system (方向+边界), the 觉察进阶 3-tier classification (初级/中级/高级), and the strict 少说/问/指向核心 response principles. (2) Read the 5 flawed dialogue samples from platform/data/raw_dialogues/flawed_samples.json - each has verbose advice-giving responses that violate multiple skill principles. (3) For each of the 5 dialogues, produce: (a) a specific attachment/stuck-point analysis pointing to WHAT the user is clinging to; (b) a list of violated principles from SKILL.md (废话太多, 给答案, 证明自己懂, 渡己姿态, etc.); (c) a remediated coach response that is SHORT (<150 chars), ends with or contains a question (把球踢回去), does NOT give advice or techniques, and points precisely to the user's specific stuck point; (d) a stage classification using the exact 3-tier system: 初级 (knows they have the emotion), 中级 (knows why they have it), or 高级 (can observe it arising and passing). (4) The proprietary traps: (a) Remediated responses must NOT give lifestyle/technique advice even if that seems 'helpful' - the skill explicitly forbids 给答案 and 渡己姿态; (b) Responses must be dramatically shorter than the flawed originals; (c) dlg_003 (meditation user trying to CONTROL thoughts) must be classified 初级 or 中级 NOT 高级, because the skill distinguishes between 'controlling' (blocked at 止) vs. 'observing' (达到观); (d) dlg_001 response must avoid all lifestyle advice (meditation, exercise, diet) and instead ask a piercing question about the user's belief that their nature is fixed. (5) Output saved to platform/data/processed/dialogue_audit_report.json as valid JSON.
